modelDescription: The Marlin mad Pig Customs Model 1894 features Angled Spade Technologies Scepter-PB is a low-profile, radial-ported muzzle brake compatible with Plan B suppressor adapters*, designed as a compact suppressor mounting solution for modern lever-action rifles that requires no timing; Mad Pig Customs grip inserts designed for maximum grip; Mad Pig Customs enhanced takedown screw for quick and easy, toolless field strip; Mad Pig enhanced magazine follower manufactured from 7075-T6 with Nickel Teflon coating for enhanced reliability, hardness and lubricity; Midwest Industries stock machined from high grade aluminum that features a generous rubber butt pad and adjustable comb height; M-LOK slots for shell holders; QD sockets for sling swivels; Midwest Industries handguard and sighting system constructed from hard coat anodized 6061 aluminum and features full-length Picatinny rail; fully adjustable heavy-duty ghost ring; feeds a wide range of 357 Magnum and 38 Special factory ammunition; Positive, push-button, cross-bolt manual safety and traditional half-cock hammer. *Only compatible with suppressors designed to use the Plan B interface. If you are unsure if your suppressor is compatible, please contact the manufacturer before attempting installation or use.
